methodology_notes: Uses saved local research and its public-source register; no new external fact or live provider outcome is introduced during manuscript drafting.
First-party seller claims, provider marketing, attributed creator statements, independent reporting, public metadata, observation notes, interpretation and hypothetical exercises remain separate.
Older observed Shorts are not relabeled as new watches; caption/index-only comparisons do not establish scene sequence or pacing.
Screenshot-only records preserve capture-date and live-readback limits; underlying supplied images are not reproduced.
Hypothetical budgets, scripts, rates and arithmetic are teaching examples rather than observed business results.
Publication, delivery, orders, revenue and own-factory commercial operation require their own records and are not inferred from this manuscript.
